⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Number of audio channels.

Must match the channel count reported by the decoder for the stream's
[`components.AudioCodec`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_codec?speculative-link). The interleaving order is defined by
[`components.AudioChannelLayout`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_channel_layout?speculative-link).
